source: Extracted from the current Harness Bench HTML source; this is an inventory, not an independently verified manufacturer database.
important_limitations: Some catalog entries are generic connectors or placeholders rather than exact manufacturer part numbers.
Most generic connector pins are numbered sequentially and have no verified function labels.
The app source itself says engine-side plugs are left blank where its source page gives no pinout.
This inventory does not validate any pinout against manufacturer documentation.
Saved designs are stored in browser localStorage under key harness-bench-v2 unless the user exports a backup from the app.
